title: That’s the Norm
description: Norm is a robot from space, Suzy Johnson is a little girl. They come from totally different worlds. If you think they’re worlds apart, you’re misinformed. Though it might seem unusual, that’s the Norm.
quote: Space is cold and unforgiving, like my father!
altHero: Norm the robot clutching his knee, Suzy looks on disapprovingly
alt1: Norm and Suzy in a bedroom
alt3: Suzy by what looks like a body covered by a sheet, Norm is holding a pitcher of lemonade
alt4: Norm hiding in the bushes, he and Suzy are winking and giving finger guns
